system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Reports a water supply issue (no water, poor quality, leakage, etc. Here are my details: my description is dummy_description_3632, my household_id is JJM-HH-1000, my issue_type is dummy_issue_type_5151.

function.name: jjm_report_issue
function.description: Reports a water supply issue (no water, poor quality, leakage, etc.). Transitions complaint_status to 'raised'. Requires session_token. Connection must be 'installed' or 'active'. Does NOT resolve issue. Fails if no active connection, duplicate complaint, or invalid issue type.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized tools.
